text: Query and combine data across multiple data sources regardless of where data is stored
quote: you create queries and expressions from multiple data sources, no matter where you store your data... create, manage, and take action on your alerts from a single, consolidated view

text: Create, manage, and act on all alerts from a single consolidated view
quote: You can then create, manage, and take action on your alerts from a single, consolidated view

text: Provision dashboards and data sources from version-controlled config files (GitOps)
quote: Grafana has an active provisioning system that uses configuration files. You can define data sources and dashboards using files that can be version controlled, making GitOps more natural.

text: Define dashboards, data sources, and configs as code with version control, testing, and CI/CD deployment
quote: This approach lets you define dashboards, data sources, and other configurations in code, enabling version control, automated testing, and reliable deployments through CI/CD pipelines.

text: Tempo lets you search traces, generate metrics from spans, and link traces with logs and metrics
quote: Tempo lets you search for traces, generate metrics from spans, and link your tracing data with logs and metrics.

text: Grafana SLO framework lets you define SLIs/SLOs to measure and act on service quality
quote: Grafana SLO (Service Level Objective) provides a framework for measuring the quality of service you provide to users.

text: Create on-call schedules, escalate alerts, and coordinate incidents through post-incident review
quote: Use it to create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to the people who are on call, and coordinate incidents from declaration through post-incident review.

text: AI agents can connect to Grafana via a hosted Cloud MCP Server or self-managed open-source MCP Server
quote: Connect AI agents to Grafana through the fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or the self-managed open source MCP Server.

text: Understand production systems faster using natural language queries
quote: Understand production systems faster using natural language

text: Explore data with ad-hoc queries and dynamic drilldown, splitting/comparing time ranges and sources side by side
quote: Explore your data through ad-hoc queries and dynamic drilldown. Split view and compare different time ranges, queries and data sources side by side.

text: Switch seamlessly from metrics to logs with preserved label filters, including live log streaming
quote: Experience the magic of switching from metrics to logs with preserved label filters. Quickly search through all your logs or streaming them live.

text: Create dynamic, reusable dashboards using dropdown template variables
quote: Create dynamic & reusable dashboards with template variables that appear as dropdowns at the top of the dashboard.

text: Mix different data sources, including custom ones, within the same graph on a per-query basis
quote: Mix different data sources in the same graph! You can specify a data source on a per-query basis. This works for even custom datasources.

text: Unified platform to query, visualize, alert on, and explore metrics, logs, and traces wherever stored
quote: enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored

text: Free tier plan available with no charges for personal projects and startups
quote: Perfect for personal projects, exploring new ideas, and early-stage startups. No charges ever.

text: Adaptive Telemetry automatically identifies important data and aggregates the rest, cutting telemetry costs up to 80%
quote: Grafana Cloud’s Adaptive Telemetry suite automatically identifies the data worth your attention and aggregates the rest, cutting your telemetry costs by up to 80%.

text: LogQL query language uses labels and operators to filter and analyze logs in Loki
quote: LogQL is Grafana Loki's query language. LogQL uses labels and operators for filtering.

text: Prometheus exemplars let you jump directly from metrics to related Tempo traces
quote: Prometheus exemplars let you jump from Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces by clicking on recorded exemplars.

text: Documented migration and upgrade paths for existing Loki deployments
quote: migrate from previous deployments, and upgrade your Loki environment

text: Grafana Alerting notifies you about system problems moments after they occur
quote: Grafana Alerting allows you to learn about problems in your systems moments after they occur.

text: Official CLI supports authentication, managing multiple environments, and admin tasks, suited for CI/CD and local dev
quote: You can authenticate, manage multiple environments, and perform administrative tasks from the terminal. It’s suitable for CI/CD pipelines, local development

text: During an incident, investigate using the same metrics, logs, and traces that triggered the alert
quote: During an incident, you can investigate with the same metrics, logs, and traces that fired the alert.

text: Run Loki locally in single-binary mode with a local filesystem backend, sending logs via Grafana Alloy
quote: Try it locally. The fastest way to experiment is to run Loki in monolithic (single-binary) mode with a local filesystem backend and send logs to it with Grafana Alloy.
